+# Funk Bot acceptance status — work in progress
+
+This is an honest snapshot, **not a parity or security certification**. None of the five requested patches is ready to ship as complete. “Partial” means only the listed subset is implemented; the cited tests do not establish the rest of the acceptance item. The README remains marked partial. External gateways can charge or retain data; use a free local model if those properties are required.
+
+| # | Status | Evidence and remaining difference |
+|---|---|---|
+| 1 | Partial | Identity, editing, deletion and duplication of identity, sprite, profile and Bot budget: `backend/app.py`, `frontend/app/page.tsx`, `backend/tests/test_identity.py`, `frontend/scripts/duplicate-e2e.mjs`. Skills are account-wide rather than Bot-assigned; routines do not exist and are not copied. |
+| 2 | Partial | One conversation per Bot, streaming and stop: `backend/app.py`, `backend/tests/test_runs.py`. Multiple chats, chat management, search and attachments are not implemented. |
+| 3 | Partial | Manual Bot memory, narrowly rule-based direct-chat capture, owner-managed shared/project layers, bounded untrusted recall: `backend/funkbot/memory_capture.py`, `backend/app.py`, `backend/tests/test_memory.py`, `frontend/scripts/memory-layers-e2e.mjs`. General extraction, automatic shared/project proposals, forgetting and out-of-date chat commands are not implemented. |
+| 4 | Partial | Approved Bot-proposed follow-ups persist and appear with due indicators in the Inbox: `backend/funkbot/tool_runtime.py`, `backend/tests/test_followups.py`, `frontend/components/inbox/FollowupsView.tsx`, `frontend/scripts/followups-e2e.mjs`. Due indicators require the app to be open; no OS push or automatic continuation is provided. |

+
+## Verification limitations
+
+The latest backend suite passed 173 tests. Frontend lint, typecheck, 13 Vitest tests and the production build passed. New shared/project memory, duplication, event-export, skills, global-pause and follow-up UI flows were exercised at 1440px and 390px against disposable local installations; their screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`. Browser tests use disposable fixture data and do not establish real-provider behavior.
+
+Docker and PowerShell are unavailable in this environment, so Compose, `scripts/docker-smoke.ps1`, actual Docker volume upgrades, network isolation and phone-on-LAN access were not run. Scheduler recovery/DST, MCP approvals, computer isolation/browser approval, kill-switch and backup/restore tests cannot pass because those features do not yet exist. There is no proof that every external action is approval-gated. The existing local secret redaction is heuristic and does not guarantee removal of unknown secrets. Do not use this partial implementation for unattended or sensitive computer work.

 - Provider names and defaults are configuration examples, not a guarantee that models are currently available. A working account/key and gateway configuration are required for live inference.
+
+### Follow-ups
+
+### Owner-initiated handoffs
+
+In a Bot spotlight, open Handoffs to choose another Bot and enter a reason and context. This immediately creates and starts a receiver mission, subject to the existing budget, pause and tool-approval controls. Both Bot spotlights show the handoff and its mission status; Office and activity show the actual recorded event. Context is untrusted data, not permission for actions. The owner initiates these handoffs; Bots cannot autonomously hand off from arbitrary chats, and these cards are not part of multiple independent chat threads. The latest 100 handoffs per Bot are shown. Deleting a Bot can leave an anonymized handoff on the other Bot; deleting the mission removes its handoff.
+
+During a response a Bot may propose a follow-up with a summary and an ISO 8601 date/time including a timezone offset. The owner must approve the displayed proposal before it is saved. Follow-ups persist across restarts, are limited to 500 open items account-wide and may be due up to 366 days ahead. The Inbox shows approved items, highlights due entries while the app is open, and lets you mark them done or delete them. The app does not launch a new run, send an email or produce an operating-system push notification when one becomes due. Deleting a Bot deletes its follow-ups.
+
+### Global pause
+
+**Pause all Bots** blocks new chat, mission and Lab starts, stops active responses and pending tool approvals, and cancels queued missions and Lab work. The paused state survives a backend restart; resuming does not replay stopped work. An action already completed cannot be undone, and an in-flight provider request can have an uncertain charge. This control covers the current single-worker runtime, not a computer sandbox or future connectors, which are not built.
+
+### Skills
+
+Use **Skills** to create, edit or delete up to 50 account-wide guides. Each has a slash command, when-to-use description, inputs, steps and checks. Type `/` in a Bot chat to select a skill, then add the request and send. A finished mission can open an unsaved skill draft containing its title and up to 6,000 characters of its instructions; review the draft and fill the missing fields before saving.
+
+Import accepts UTF-8 `SKILL.md` files up to 32 KB in either a simple `#` title with `## When to use`, `## Inputs`, `## Steps`, and `## Checks` sections, or simple one-line `name` and `description` frontmatter followed by a Markdown body (up to 6,000 characters). Frontmatter imports leave inputs and checks for you to fill. This is not a full YAML or complete SKILL.md implementation. Import previews only: review and save manually. No document code, links or commands are executed during import. Skill instructions and tool output are untrusted task data, not authorization; existing tool approvals and budget caps still apply.
+
+### Event export
+
+In **Settings → Tool audit**, export the recorded account event log as JSON or CSV. The authenticated export streams in event order and reapplies known-secret filtering, but no filter is complete. Exports are private and may include message summaries. CSV cells that resemble spreadsheet formulas are prefixed for safety. This is an event export, not a complete tool-audit export or workspace backup. Deleting a Bot deletes its event history.

+@app.put('/api/control/pause')
+async def put_global_pause(body: PauseIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO config VALUES (?,?)',('global_pause','1' if body.paused else '0'))
+        if body.paused:

+            c.execute("UPDATE lab_experiments SET status='failed',error='Stopped by global pause.',updated_at=? WHERE status='queued'",(now,))
+            c.execute("UPDATE lab_runs SET status='failed',error='Stopped by global pause.',updated_at=? WHERE status='queued'",(now,))
+    if body.paused:
+        # Single-worker runtime: cancel current tasks after atomically blocking
+        # new starts. Already completed external actions cannot be reversed.
+        tasks=set()

+                job['user_cancelled']=True;job['task'].cancel();tasks.add(job['task'])
+        for task in [*mission_tasks.values(),*lab_tasks.values()]:
+            if not task.done(): task.cancel();tasks.add(task)
+        if tasks: await asyncio.gather(*tasks,return_exceptions=True)
+    return {'paused':body.paused}

+def redact_event_value(value, keys):
+    if isinstance(value,str): return redact_text(value,keys)
+    if isinstance(value,list): return [redact_event_value(item,keys) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value,dict): return {key:redact_event_value(item,keys) for key,item in value.items()}
+    return value

+def csv_safe(value):
+    if isinstance(value,str) and (value.startswith(('\t','\r','\n')) or value.lstrip().startswith(('=','+','-','@'))):
+        return "'"+value
+    return value

+"""Local skill document parsing and explicit slash-invocation parsing."""
+import re
+
+INVOCATION = re.compile(r'^/([a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31})(?:\s+([\s\S]*))?$',re.ASCII)
+HEADINGS = {'when to use':'when_to_use','inputs':'inputs','steps':'steps','checks':'checks'}
+
+
+def parse_invocation(content):
+    return INVOCATION.fullmatch(content.strip())
+
+
+def parse_markdown(text):
+    """Parse a deliberately small, readable subset, not arbitrary frontmatter.
+
+    Imported text is data: no links are fetched, no commands are executed and
+    no tool permissions are changed. An owner must review and save the draft.
+    """
+    lines=text.replace('\r\n','\n').replace('\r','\n').split('\n')
+    if lines and lines[0].strip()=='---':
+        try: end=lines.index('---',1)
+        except ValueError as exc: raise ValueError('The frontmatter is not closed.') from exc
+        metadata={}
+        for line in lines[1:end]:
+            match=re.fullmatch(r'(name|description):\s*(.*?)\s*',line)
+            if match:
+                value=match.group(2)
+                if len(value)>1 and value[0]==value[-1] and value[0] in ('\"',"'"): value=value[1:-1]
+                metadata[match.group(1)]=value.strip()
+        name=metadata.get('name','');description=metadata.get('description','');body='\n'.join(lines[end+1:]).strip()
+        if not name or not description or not body: raise ValueError('Frontmatter requires single-line name and description, plus a body.')
+        if len(name)>120 or len(description)>4000 or len(body)>6000: raise ValueError('Name, description or body exceed the skill editor limits.')
+        # Leave missing fields blank; the owner must supply them before saving.
+        return {'name':name,'when_to_use':description,'inputs':'','steps':body,'checks':''}
+    name='';section=None;seen=set();parts={key:[] for key in HEADINGS.values()}
+    for line in lines:
+        if line.startswith('# ') and not name and not section:
+            name=line[2:].strip();continue
+        if line.startswith('## '):
+            key=line[3:].strip().lower()
+            if key not in HEADINGS: raise ValueError('Use only When to use, Inputs, Steps, and Checks headings.')
+            section=HEADINGS[key]
+            if section in seen: raise ValueError('Do not repeat a heading.')
+            seen.add(section)
+            continue
+        if section: parts[section].append(line)
+        elif line.strip(): raise ValueError('Start with a title followed by the required headings.')
+    fields={key:'\n'.join(value).strip() for key,value in parts.items()}
+    if not name or any(not value for value in fields.values()):
+        raise ValueError('A title and all four non-empty sections are required.')
+    return {'name':name,**fields}

+def test_skill_crud_limits_import_and_authentication():
+    with TestClient(service.app) as c:
+        assert c.get('/api/skills').status_code==401
+        setup(c)

+        assert c.post('/api/skills/import-preview',files={'file':('SKILL.md',b'# Incomplete','text/markdown')}).status_code==400
+        assert c.post('/api/skills/import-preview',files={'file':('SKILL.md',b'x'*32769,'text/markdown')}).status_code==413

+        assert c.post('/api/skills',json=payload(slug='overflow')).status_code==400
+        assert c.delete('/api/skills/'+skill).status_code==200

+// Test-only deterministic mock model. Never use as a production gateway.
+import http from 'node:http';
+const port=Number(process.env.MOCK_PORT||8042);
+http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{
+ if(req.method!=='POST'||req.url!=='/v1/chat/completions'){res.writeHead(404).end();return}
+ let raw='';for await(const part of req)raw+=part;const payload=JSON.parse(raw);const hasTool=payload.messages.at(-1)?.role==='tool';const chunks=[];
+ if(!hasTool){const args={summary:'Finish the fixture research',due:new Date(Date.now()+12000).toISOString()};chunks.push({choices:[{delta:{tool_calls:[{index:0,id:'followup',function:{name:'create_followup',arguments:JSON.stringify(args)}}]},finish_reason:null}]});chunks.push({choices:[{delta:{},finish_reason:'tool_calls'}]})}
+ else chunks.push({choices:[{delta:{content:'Follow-up recorded.'},finish_reason:'stop'}]});
+ chunks.push({choices:[],usage:{prompt_tokens:200,completion_tokens:50}});res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/event-stream'});for(const chunk of chunks)res.write('data: '+JSON.stringify(chunk)+'\n\n');res.end('data: [DONE]\n\n');
+}).listen(port,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log(`Disposable follow-up gateway listening on ${port}`));
